Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Balamb Garden
Description: Gardening companion: stand by your garden and water, harvest, or replant a whole patch - or every ripe pot in the house - with one button, at a patient human pace. Keeps a ledger of what's planted where, when you watered it, and when it will be ripe (down to the afternoon). Tips watch your crossbreed pipelines and say when a chain is about to starve. /garden to open.
Changelog: When a bed is sown, by hand or by the plugin, its ripe time is now exact instead of a guess, and a bed you just harvested and replanted shows a tight window right away. Hand harvests and hand sowings count now, not just the ones the plugin does for you. Behind the scenes the plugin also keeps a record of every planting and harvest from both of you: how much came in, and which cross seeds dropped or didn't (a screen to browse it comes later). Your first load after updating converts the garden file to a new format and keeps a backup beside it.
